thread:
maria.ae: Heads-up: Acme Fin wants a 3-week POC focusing on doc search + Q&A, reranking top results, and a secure tool call to their balance API. We need alignment on success criteria, model choice (context vs embeddings), and quick hosted vs dedicated pricing for 50k queries.

ben.se: Clarify: do they want full-document in-context answers (32k) or chunk+embed+rerkank approach? That changes cost a lot.

maria.ae: Customer said "upload full monthly statements" and would like answers citing exact paragraph. They prefer minimal infra lift so hosted if possible.

jordan.ml: For paragraph-level attribution with documents intact, a 32k context model is simplest. If we chunk and use embeddings + rerank we can get lower cost and often better precision but need indexing. Trade-offs: latency and exact-match behavior.

lisa.cs: Security checklist from Acme: SSO (SAML), KMS keys, 90-day audit logs retention, and EU data residency (eu-west-1). Any hosted blockers?

ben.se: Hosted supports KMS + SAML on enterprise tiers. EU regional hosting is possible but we need to confirm DPA/SOC2 language. Dedicated gives stronger residency guarantees. I'll flag to infra.

maria.ae: They also asked about tool calling to their internal API which requires client-cert mTLS. Is that supported from hosted?

lisa.cs: Short answer: mTLS with client certs is only supported via Private (VPC) deployments today. Hosted can make outbound HTTPS calls but not present client certs for mTLS. Dedicated/private solves that.

maria.ae: Ok mark that as a blocker for hosted. We'll include Dedicated option in the quote.

jordan.ml: For success criteria, propose: 1) >=90% exact-match on a 200-prompt eval set, 2) p50 E2E latency <=800ms warm, <=1.5s cold, 3) reranker increases top-1 precision by >=15% vs embeddings-only, 4) toolcall success >=98% with graceful fallback. Add metrics for attribution correctness.

ben.se: Sounds good. On the cost estimate: 50k queries x avg 800 tokens = ~40M tokens. Option A (32k model hosted): higher token cost but simpler. Option B (chunking + embeddings + rerank hosted): embeddings cost + extra compute for reranker but lower model token use. Option C (Dedicated reserved pool): fixed monthly fee + much lower per-token unit. I'll produce two hosted scenarios + one dedicated ballpark.

jordan.ml: We'll also simulate an embedding+rerank baseline on a 1k sample to estimate top1 lift. For reranker design, I recommend: ANN (faiss) recall -> top-k rerank with a smaller decoder to keep latency down. Test failure modes for tool calls: timeouts, 500s, malformed payload. Define rollback: on toolcall failure, model asks clarifying question instead of returning stale data.

maria.ae: Can someone draft a short eval harness I can share? Need it in simple YAML they can run or we run for them.

jordan.ml: Example config block below you can send:

```
# eval_config.yaml
project: acme_poc
eval_set: acme_statements_200
models:
  - rw-infer-gpt-32k
  - rw-infer-gpt-8k_embeddings_rerank
metrics:
  - exact_match
  - top1_precision
  - latency_p50
  - toolcall_success_rate
requests: 200
timeout_ms: 12000
cache_modes:
  - cold
  - warm
```

ben.se: Proposed rollout: Week0 prep + synthetic evals, Week1 internal demo + small sandbox with customer engineers, Week2 extended sandbox + load test, Week3 go/no-go and handoff. Fits 3-week window if infra reservation aligns.

lisa.cs: I'll assemble the DPA snippet, retention language, and confirm SAML + KMS support with legal. Expect a note by EOD tomorrow.

maria.ae: Action items: Ben & Jordan - cost scenarios and initial eval results; Lisa - compliance snippet; Ben - cc infra on pricing email. Please include expected cost drivers: context length, batching, KV cache hit-rate, rerank compute.

ben.se: On it. I'll send two hosted cost scenarios (32k vs embedding+rerkank) and a Dedicated estimate for a 3-month commitment.

jordan.ml: I'll run a quick embed+rerank sim and post numbers here tomorrow AM.

maria.ae: One more for customer: clarify whether they can accept toolcall via a proxy in their VPC (would that be an acceptable workaround vs mTLS?).

lisa.cs: If they can host a proxy endpoint inside their VPC that accepts client certs and speaks mutual TLS to their internal API, we can call that from Dedicated/Private. Hosted cannot reach into their VPC.

maria.ae: Thanks. deploy-bot: any ETA on the POC sandbox cluster?

deploy-bot: scheduled-deploy: reserved sandbox cluster for acme-poc on 1971237700; will post readiness when done.

maria.ae: Great. I'll send the acceptance checklist and timeline to the customer after Ben/Jordan post costs and eval. Closing loop here. :thumbsup:
